stem.text: A loudspeaker emits a sound wave into a tube initially full of water.

stem.alt: Vertical tube full of water, with a loudspeaker at the top and a tap at the bottom. Labels show the tube and water, and dimension arrows labelled x and y mark two lengths from the top of the tube.

stem.text: A tap at the bottom of the tube is opened so that water slowly leaves the tube. For some lengths of the air column in the tube, the sound heard is much louder.
The first loud sound is heard when the air column in the tube has length $x$.
The next time that a loud sound is heard is when the air column in the tube has length $y$.
What is the wavelength of the sound wave from the loudspeaker?
